name: mrskwiw-plugins
description: Agent tooling by mrskwiw / knot0 — web QA, web replication, novel writing, spec pressure-testing, and a persistent REPL scratchpad.

plugins.name: web-qa
plugins.description: AI-assisted web-application QA: enters a web app as a real user, drives a headless browser through end-to-end journeys, captures evidence (DOM, console, network, screenshot), applies deterministic gates, and judges whether the user's goal was actually achieved — catching bugs that pass every objective check but are still wrong.

plugins.name: web-replicate
plugins.description: Reconstruction-grade documentation of a web app so it can be REBUILT: drives every user journey in a headless browser, captures markup/assets/traffic, infers the backend contract (endpoints, shapes, auth), and writes a rebuild blueprint. Sibling of web-qa.

plugins.name: claude-novel-writer
plugins.description: AI-assisted novel writing for Claude Code — structure, consistency tracking, context assembly, and prose analysis.

plugins.name: vibe-testing
plugins.description: Pressure-test specs with LLM reasoning before writing code — validate spec documents by simulating real-world scenarios against them.

plugins.name: repl-scratchpad
plugins.description: Persistent Python REPL for coding agents — variables survive across turns and only print() output enters context.
